name: A multimodal dataset bridging brain activity, cognition, and real-world collective behavior
description: Naturalistic narrative-video recordings from 65 participants with usable EEG after six exclusions from 71 recruits. The 64-channel acquisition comprises 59 EEG channels plus ECG/EOG. Fourteen experimental videos span seven semantic themes with grand versus individual narrative perspectives; each participant viewed one version per theme. Multidimensional subjective evaluations, demographics and psychological traits accompany stimulus-level Bilibili engagement metrics (plays, likes, comments, danmaku, saves, coin rewards and shares), enabling exploratory links between neural synchrony, psychological responses and real-world collective engagement. OSF provides raw BDF recordings in RAR archives, preprocessed FIF recordings, stimulus annotations, aggregated measures and MNE-Python preprocessing scripts. Download files from the Raw_EEG, Preprocessed_EEG, Aggregated_data, Stimulus_Videos and Codes folders; consult ReadMe.docx for formats and use instructions. The paper and repository README specify CC BY 4.0 and downloads without an access request; the OSF project license field is unset. Original videos are excluded for copyright reasons. Narrative comparisons are stimulus-bound, and platform confounds limit causal and neuroforecasting claims. A separate code license was not verified.
citation: Deng Y, Lin H, Wu J, Guo X, Li M, Wang Y, Xiao H, Zhang Y. (2026). A multimodal dataset bridging brain activity, cognition, and real-world collective behavior. Scientific Data. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-026-08410-w
